bible_quanes.question: What did Daniel purpose in his heart?
bible_quanes.answer: Not to defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine

bible_quanes.question: What did Daniel ask to eat during the ten-day test?
bible_quanes.answer: Pulse, and water to drink

bible_quanes.question: How did Daniel and his friends look after ten days?
bible_quanes.answer: Fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the king's meat

bible_quanes.question: Which king besieged Jerusalem in Daniel 1?
bible_quanes.answer: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
bible_quanes.explanation: In the third year of Jehoiakim.

bible_quanes.question: What Babylonian names were given to Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah?
bible_quanes.answer: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego

bible_quanes.question: With whom did God give Daniel favour?
bible_quanes.answer: The prince of the eunuchs

bible_quanes.question: What special gift did God give Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: Understanding in all visions and dreams

bible_quanes.question: How much better did the king find them than his magicians?
bible_quanes.answer: Ten times better

bible_quanes.question: Who was the steward set over Daniel and his friends?
bible_quanes.answer: Melzar

bible_quanes.question: Until when did Daniel continue?
bible_quanes.answer: The first year of King Cyrus

bible_quanes.question: What troubled Nebuchadnezzar in Daniel 2?
bible_quanes.answer: Dreams

bible_quanes.question: How was the secret revealed to Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: In a night vision

bible_quanes.question: Of what was the head of the image made?
bible_quanes.answer: Fine gold

bible_quanes.question: What will the God of heaven set up?
bible_quanes.answer: A kingdom which shall never be destroyed

bible_quanes.question: What did the king demand of the wise men?
bible_quanes.answer: To tell him the dream and its interpretation

bible_quanes.question: What were the image's feet made of?
bible_quanes.answer: Part of iron and part of clay

bible_quanes.question: What struck the image?
bible_quanes.answer: A stone cut out without hands

bible_quanes.question: Whom did the head of gold represent?
bible_quanes.answer: "Thou, O king... art this head of gold"

bible_quanes.question: What did the stone become?
bible_quanes.answer: A great mountain, and filled the whole earth

bible_quanes.question: What position did Nebuchadnezzar give Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: Ruler over the province of Babylon and chief of the wise men

bible_quanes.question: How tall was Nebuchadnezzar's gold image?
bible_quanes.answer: Threescore cubits

bible_quanes.question: What would happen to whoever did not bow?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace

bible_quanes.question: What did Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego say God was able to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Deliver them from the furnace

bible_quanes.question: How many men did the king see walking in the fire?
bible_quanes.answer: Four
bible_quanes.explanation: The fourth like the Son of God.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Nebuchadnezzar set up the image?
bible_quanes.answer: The plain of Dura

bible_quanes.question: How much hotter was the furnace heated?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven times more than it was wont to be heated

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the men who threw them in?
bible_quanes.answer: The flame of the fire slew them

bible_quanes.question: What was not on the three men?
bible_quanes.answer: The smell of fire

bible_quanes.question: Which instruments signaled the time to bow?
bible_quanes.answer: The cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery and dulcimer

bible_quanes.question: What decree did Nebuchadnezzar make afterward?
bible_quanes.answer: Every people which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces
bible_quanes.explanation: No other god can deliver like this.

bible_quanes.question: What did Nebuchadnezzar see in his dream in chapter 4?
bible_quanes.answer: A great tree in the midst of the earth

bible_quanes.question: With whom would Nebuchadnezzar dwell?
bible_quanes.answer: The beasts of the field
bible_quanes.explanation: He would eat grass like oxen.

bible_quanes.question: What did Nebuchadnezzar do when his reason returned?
bible_quanes.answer: Praise and extol and honour the King of heaven
bible_quanes.explanation: Those who walk in pride He can humble.

bible_quanes.question: What did Nebuchadnezzar boast?
bible_quanes.answer: "Is not this great Babylon, that I have built?"

bible_quanes.question: What did the watcher command about the tree?
bible_quanes.answer: Hew down the tree, but leave the stump of his roots
bible_quanes.explanation: With a band of iron and brass.

bible_quanes.question: How long would Nebuchadnezzar's heart be changed?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven times

bible_quanes.question: What did Daniel advise the king?
bible_quanes.answer: Break off his sins by righteousness and his iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor

bible_quanes.question: How long did Nebuchadnezzar's hair grow?
bible_quanes.answer: Like eagles' feathers
bible_quanes.explanation: And his nails like birds' claws.

bible_quanes.question: Who decreed the judgment on Nebuchadnezzar?
bible_quanes.answer: The watchers (holy ones)
bible_quanes.explanation: That the living may know the Most High rules.

bible_quanes.question: How long after the dream did the judgment come?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve months

bible_quanes.question: Who made a great feast in Daniel 5?
bible_quanes.answer: Belshazzar the king

bible_quanes.question: What appeared during the feast?
bible_quanes.answer: The fingers of a man's hand writing on the wall

bible_quanes.question: What words were written on the wall?
bible_quanes.answer: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Belshazzar that night?
bible_quanes.answer: He was slain

bible_quanes.question: From what did Belshazzar and his guests drink?
bible_quanes.answer: The golden and silver vessels taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: Who told the king about Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: The queen

bible_quanes.question: What did TEKEL mean?
bible_quanes.answer: Weighed in the balances and found wanting

bible_quanes.question: Who received the kingdom?
bible_quanes.answer: Darius the Median

bible_quanes.question: What position was given to Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: Third ruler in the kingdom

bible_quanes.question: What did PERES mean?
bible_quanes.answer: The kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians

bible_quanes.question: How many times a day did Daniel pray?
bible_quanes.answer: Three
bible_quanes.explanation: With his windows open toward Jerusalem.

bible_quanes.question: Where was Daniel thrown?
bible_quanes.answer: The den of lions

bible_quanes.question: How was Daniel saved from the lions?
bible_quanes.answer: God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths

bible_quanes.question: What did Darius decree afterward?
bible_quanes.answer: That men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel

bible_quanes.question: How many satraps did Darius set over the kingdom?
bible_quanes.answer: One hundred and twenty

bible_quanes.question: What decree did the officials ask the king to sign?
bible_quanes.answer: No one could petition any god or man but the king for thirty days

bible_quanes.question: Why could the decree not be changed?
bible_quanes.answer: It was the law of the Medes and Persians

bible_quanes.question: How did the king react when he learned of the trap?
bible_quanes.answer: He was sore displeased and laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver Daniel

bible_quanes.question: How did Darius spend the night?
bible_quanes.answer: Fasting, with no instruments of musick, and his sleep went from him

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Daniel's accusers?
bible_quanes.answer: Them, their children, and their wives, cast into the den of lions

bible_quanes.question: In which king's first year did Daniel have the dream of chapter 7?
bible_quanes.answer: Belshazzar

bible_quanes.question: What came up from the sea in Daniel 7?
bible_quanes.answer: Four great beasts

bible_quanes.question: Who did Daniel see sitting on the throne?
bible_quanes.answer: The Ancient of Days

bible_quanes.question: Who came with the clouds of heaven?
bible_quanes.answer: One like the Son of Man

bible_quanes.question: What was the first beast like?
bible_quanes.answer: A lion with eagle's wings

bible_quanes.question: What was the second beast like?
bible_quanes.answer: A bear with three ribs in its mouth

bible_quanes.question: What was the third beast like?
bible_quanes.answer: A leopard with four wings and four heads

bible_quanes.question: How many horns did the fourth beast have?
bible_quanes.answer: Ten

bible_quanes.question: What came up among the ten horns?
bible_quanes.answer: Another little horn, with eyes and a mouth speaking great things

bible_quanes.question: For how long will the saints be given into the horn's hand?
bible_quanes.answer: A time and times and the dividing of time

bible_quanes.question: What animal did Daniel see by the river in chapter 8?
bible_quanes.answer: A ram which had two horns

bible_quanes.question: What came from the west?
bible_quanes.answer: An he goat with a notable horn
bible_quanes.explanation: It did not touch the ground.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did the ram represent?
bible_quanes.answer: The kings of Media and Persia

bible_quanes.question: Whom did the male goat represent?
bible_quanes.answer: The king of Grecia
bible_quanes.explanation: The large horn was its first king.

bible_quanes.question: Where was Daniel in his vision?
bible_quanes.answer: At Shushan by the River Ulai

bible_quanes.question: What happened when the goat's large horn was broken?
bible_quanes.answer: Four notable horns came up

bible_quanes.question: After how many days would the sanctuary be cleansed?
bible_quanes.answer: Two thousand and three hundred days

bible_quanes.question: Which angel explained the vision to Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: Gabriel

bible_quanes.question: What came out of one of the four horns?
bible_quanes.answer: A little horn which waxed exceeding great

bible_quanes.question: How did Daniel react after the vision?
bible_quanes.answer: He fainted and was sick for days

bible_quanes.question: From which prophet's book did Daniel understand the seventy years?
bible_quanes.answer: Jeremiah

bible_quanes.question: How did Daniel seek God?
bible_quanes.answer: By prayer and supplications, with fasting, sackcloth and ashes

bible_quanes.question: Who came to Daniel while he prayed?
bible_quanes.answer: Gabriel

bible_quanes.question: How many weeks were determined for Daniel's people?
bible_quanes.answer: Seventy weeks

bible_quanes.question: What did Daniel confess in his prayer?
bible_quanes.answer: "We have sinned and committed iniquity"

bible_quanes.question: On what basis did Daniel pray?
bible_quanes.answer: Not for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies

bible_quanes.question: What did Gabriel say about Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: He was greatly beloved

bible_quanes.question: How many weeks until the Messiah the Prince?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks
bible_quanes.explanation: From the command to restore Jerusalem.

bible_quanes.question: What would happen to the Messiah after the sixty-two weeks?
bible_quanes.answer: Messiah shall be cut off, but not for himself

bible_quanes.question: What would be brought to an end in the middle of the week?
bible_quanes.answer: The sacrifice and the oblation

bible_quanes.question: How long did Daniel mourn?
bible_quanes.answer: Three full weeks

bible_quanes.question: What did Daniel see by the river?
bible_quanes.answer: A certain man clothed in linen

bible_quanes.question: What did the messenger tell Daniel not to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Fear
bible_quanes.explanation: His words were heard from the first day.

bible_quanes.question: What did the messenger say to strengthen Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: "O man greatly beloved, fear not! Peace be to you"

bible_quanes.question: By which river was Daniel?
bible_quanes.answer: The great river, the Hiddekel (Hiddekel)

bible_quanes.question: What was the man's face like?
bible_quanes.answer: The appearance of lightning
bible_quanes.explanation: His eyes like torches of fire.

bible_quanes.question: Who withstood the messenger for twenty-one days?
bible_quanes.answer: The prince of the kingdom of Persia

bible_quanes.question: Who came to help the messenger?
bible_quanes.answer: Michael, one of the chief princes

bible_quanes.question: Who would come after the prince of Persia?
bible_quanes.answer: The prince of Grecia

bible_quanes.question: In which year of Cyrus did this vision come?
bible_quanes.answer: The third year

bible_quanes.question: How many more kings would arise in Persia?
bible_quanes.answer: Three, and a fourth far richer than all

bible_quanes.question: What will the people who know their God do?
bible_quanes.answer: Be strong and do exploits

bible_quanes.question: What kind of king would arise, according to Daniel 11:3?
bible_quanes.answer: A mighty king, that shall rule with great dominion

bible_quanes.question: What will the king do, according to Daniel 11:36?
bible_quanes.answer: Exalt and magnify himself above every god

bible_quanes.question: What happens to the mighty king's kingdom?
bible_quanes.answer: It is broken up and divided toward the four winds

bible_quanes.question: Which kings are the focus of Daniel 11?
bible_quanes.answer: The king of the South and the king of the North

bible_quanes.question: What will forces place in the sanctuary?
bible_quanes.answer: The abomination that maketh desolate
bible_quanes.explanation: They take away the daily sacrifices.

bible_quanes.question: What will those who understand do?
bible_quanes.answer: Instruct many
bible_quanes.explanation: Though they fall by sword and flame.

bible_quanes.question: Which ships come against the king of the North?
bible_quanes.answer: The ships of Chittim

bible_quanes.question: Where will the king plant his palace tents?
bible_quanes.answer: Between the seas and the glorious holy mountain
bible_quanes.explanation: Yet he will come to his end.

bible_quanes.question: Who will stand up at that time?
bible_quanes.answer: Michael, the great prince

bible_quanes.question: What will happen to many who sleep in the dust?
bible_quanes.answer: They shall awake
bible_quanes.explanation: Some to everlasting life, some to shame.

bible_quanes.question: How will those who are wise shine?
bible_quanes.answer: As the brightness of the firmament
bible_quanes.explanation: And those who turn many to righteousness like the stars.

bible_quanes.question: What was Daniel told to do with the book?
bible_quanes.answer: Shut up the words and seal the book
bible_quanes.explanation: Until the time of the end.

bible_quanes.question: What will happen at the time of the end?
bible_quanes.answer: Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase

bible_quanes.question: Why was Daniel told to go his way?
bible_quanes.answer: The words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end

bible_quanes.question: What will happen to the wicked?
bible_quanes.answer: The wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand

bible_quanes.question: What was Daniel promised at the end?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days

bible_quanes.question: How many days are given from the abolition of the daily sacrifice?
bible_quanes.answer: A thousand two hundred and ninety days

bible_quanes.question: Who is blessed in Daniel 12:12?
bible_quanes.answer: He that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days
